make-cli.what: Build the terminal-only binary (CGO off, cross-compiles anywhere)

make-build.what: Build the GUI binary natively (cgo webview; Linux adds the gtk3 tag)

make-test.what: Vet and test with the platform's GUI tags

go-test-nogui.what: Full test suite without the GUI, the way local runs avoid needing GTK/webview headers

race-tests.what: The race-detector suites CI runs (gateway, redact, provider usage)

make-dev.what: Run the app in dev mode: UI hot-reloads, Go changes rebuild the backend behind live windows (ports 3426-3429)

make-app.what: Bundle the macOS menu-bar app (magpie.app) — DESTRUCTIVE: deletes and rebuilds the bundle

make-release.what: Cross-compile all release artifacts into dist/

gh-pr.what: Open a PR from a qq/sp<N> feature branch into main — outward-facing

wrangler-site.what: Deploy the usemagpie.ai site from site/ — outward-facing production deploy of the upstream domain; do not run in this fork

none.what: None of the project tools is relevant to this request.
